newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's NSW posts A$107 mln July surplus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's NSW posts A$107 mln July surplus.

text.p: The Australian state of New South Wales (NSW) posted a A$107 million surplus in July 1996, compared to a A$23 million deficit for July 1995, the state government said in Monday.
The NSW government last month said the preliminary 1995/96 (July-June) deficit was A$113 million.
The A$107 million July surplus resulted from a A$296 million surplus on the current account and a A$189 million capital account deficit.
NSW Treasurer Michael Eagan said the improvement over July 1995 was largely due to strong growth in stamp duty revenue and the early receipt of fire brigade levies and commonwealth grants.
